These 7 models are populations of agents following local rules, so their outcomes emerge from interaction and differ from run to run. Each one is a NetLogo 6.4 model, run across parameter values and random seeds by an [nlrx](https://docs.ropensci.org/nlrx/) experiment in R. Its page charts those results and also replays the same rules in your browser so you can watch a single run unfold. Every other model on this site is equation-based and computed live on its page.

::: {#models}
